about: When a routine (a town sweep, a parked-case review) last re-read each hand-checked pin's sources. Kept apart from the pin files so a routine check never changes a fingerprint or needs an owner approval. A routine may change only a pin's entry here: last_checked_at, the record the check is written in, and optionally outcome (no_new_information); anything else is refused (tools/pin_clocks.py). Only a check with a written record goes here; none is back-filled. A pin with no entry has not been re-checked since it was approved. Material updates are not recorded here: they need an owner approval with material set. The map's 'Last reviewed' date is the later of last_checked_at and the last material update (docs/signals/REVIEW_DATES.md).
